proposed_from.topic: Universal resampling-degeneracy certificates and power-optimal exact kernels for network exposure-effect quantiles. For a finite positive design law π on Ω and a directed legal-support relation L, let K be a row-stochastic kernel supported on L and define d_K(A) as the minimum over orderings σ of nonempty A of the maximum prefix mass K(σ_j,{σ_1,…,σ_j}). Prove that upper-tail p-values from K are super-uniform for every real score vector iff d_K(A)≥π(A) for every nonempty A; derive the peeling/core equivalence, O(|Ω|2^|Ω|) recursion and violated-subset certificate, exact union-of-polyhedra description, and a certified mixed-integer optimizer for power against a prespecified alternative catalogue. Within predeclared imputable network-exposure fibers, compute worst-case p-values over sharp schedules having at most r direct effects above c and invert the nested family into exact simultaneous lower bounds for exposure-specific effect quantiles. Credit Caughey–Dafoe–Li–Miratrix for bounded-null quantile RI, Owusu and Hoshino for network conditional tests, Zhang–Zhao for partition-sufficient conditional randomization, and Ramdas et al. for arbitrary-permutation constructions; use Owusu's Cai–de Janvry–Sadoulet weather-insurance reanalysis as the consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The score-blind presolve derived the universal-validity iff by ordering rejection sets and constructing a strict score order from every violating subset; it derived d_K(A)=min_i max{K(i,A),d_K(A\{i})}, the equivalent nonempty-core certificate, exact O(m2^m) separation, and a finite disjunctive MILP. It solved the uniform three-state cyclic nonpartition kernel and proved composite bounded-null validity using the supremum over null-consistent sharp schedules. Threshold equality, ties, zero-mass states, missing self-loops, outcome adaptation, tiny fibers, naive Monte Carlo, generic disjunctive collapse, and Ramdas et al. were checked; no collision was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: For a fixed network rank statistic and legal exposure fiber, prove a terminating exact weak-order, LP, or MILP reduction of the worst-case composite-null p-value over schedules with at most r effects above c, including the simultaneous quantile-projection identity. EARLY KILL TEST: On one actual Cai/Owusu exposure fiber at α=0.05, compare the globally optimized kernel with every partition kernel and compute one bounded-null quantile p-value exactly; stop or pivot if legal support forces partitions, no strict certified power gain exists, or exact worst-case computation changes the target. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest validity result, Zhang and Zhao (2023, Theorem 1), uses one conditional distribution shared within each partition cell. The proposed kernel may have overlapping cyclic rows and is characterized by a score-uniform necessary-and-sufficient subset inequality, with necessity supplied by a strict score order built from any violating subset. Ramdas et al. (2023, Theorem 2) allow arbitrary permutation laws only after an auxiliary random reference restores exchangeability; their own failure example shows why deleting that randomization is not automatic. Caughey et al. (2023, Theorem 4) give individual effect-quantile confidence sets, and their Section 5.5 gives simultaneous joint inference; Su and Li (2024, Theorems 1 and 3) obtain a separable stratified reduction. Chen and Li (2026) are the closest newer no-interference comparator because their finite-sample distribution and quantile improvements span completely randomized, stratified randomized, sampling-based, and matched designs, but their constructions do not impose one potential-outcome schedule shared across assignment-indexed network ranks. The unresolved kernel is exactly that assignment coupling on an imputable network fiber. The combined advance is therefore a new validity class, a certified design problem over that class, and an exact finite route to a different causal target: quantiles of individual direct effects at a fixed peer exposure.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize universal super-uniformity of the unmodified state-dependent tail value by the subset degeneracy inequalities, use the resulting finite disjunction to optimize power, and carry exactness into bounded-null network-effect-quantile inversion.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 1, its probability-integral-transform proof in Appendix B, and Section 6 were read. The paper proves validity for kernels induced by assignment-space partitions; the first changed proof step is to replace conditioning on one common cell distribution by an ordering argument that controls all row-dependent rejection sets.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for state-dependent resampling kernels, stochastic-matrix randomization \(p\)-values, and Markov-kernel super-uniformity returned partition conditional randomization, auxiliary permutation symmetrization, and unrelated bootstrap kernels, but no score-uniform necessary-and-sufficient row-kernel theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Zhang and Zhao because each row can be viewed as conditioning on a cell.
seed_details.rebuttal: Overlapping cyclic rows need not be identical on any partition cell, while the necessity direction quantifies over every score ordering and is absent from the partition proof.

seed_details.kernel: Give a terminating weak-order mixed-integer reduction of the sharp-schedule supremum for a fixed rank statistic on an imputable network-exposure fiber, then invert it for individual-effect quantiles.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Sections 5.3--5.5, Theorem 4, the appendix proof architecture, and the Conclusion were read. Their key simplification uses effect-increasing or distribution-free ranks under exchangeable binary treatment; the first changed proof step is to encode how one shared schedule induces several assignment-specific rank comparisons on a network fiber.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for bounded-null network-interference quantiles and exact network quantile randomization inference found work on outcome-distribution quantile effects and randomized-saturation bounded nulls, but not finite-population quantiles of exposure-specific individual effects optimized over compatible sharp schedules.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Caughey et al. because a worst-case \(p\)-value is always obtained by setting the largest treated responses to infinity.
seed_details.rebuttal: A schedule coordinate changes ranks under several legal assignments, so the exchangeable no-interference corner argument is not separable and does not identify the network optimum.

seed_details.kernel: Optimize exact catalogue rejection probability over all universally valid kernels supported by a legal relation and return a global certificate and a partition-benchmark gap.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, the power formula and its proof around equations (32)--(37), and the Conclusion were read. Their criterion depends on normality, constant effects, balance, and assignment correlations; the first changed proof step is to optimize exact finite rejection indicators subject to the complete validity disjunction rather than optimize the proxy \(\Theta\) within bicliques.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for power-optimal interference randomization tests and exact legal-kernel optimization returned biclique heuristics and fixed-test minimax power results, but no global optimization over state-dependent valid rows.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Yanagi and Sei because their refined biclique already maximizes test power.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their algorithm remains inside biclique partitions and optimizes a model-based proxy; the proposed decision space strictly contains partition kernels and uses the exact finite rejection probability.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize the directed legal relations for which every universally valid kernel is partition-equivalent and construct a power-separating cyclic kernel whenever the criterion fails.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 1, the biclique validity proof around equations (20)--(22), the power discussion, and the concluding discussion were read. The first changed proof step replaces a biclique decomposition with directed subset-core analysis of overlapping kernel rows.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining conditional randomization, partitions, kernels, and directed legality found biclique and focal-unit constructions but no partition-exhaustiveness theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from biclique decomposition because every legal comparison graph can be decomposed into bicliques.
seed_details.rebuttal: A decomposition selects disjoint conditioning events, whereas universally valid cyclic rows may overlap and cannot be represented by any realized-cell partition.
seed_details.drop_reason: The exact graph criterion is less mature than the verified subset characterization and is retained as a later structural extension.

seed_details.kernel: Identify exactly when an unmodified deterministic row kernel is valid without the auxiliary reference permutation used to restore exchangeability.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 2 and Corollaries 2--3, the exchangeability proof via forward and backward Markov steps, and the Conclusion were read. The first changed proof step discards auxiliary-reference exchangeability and instead converts every violating subset into a strict score order.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for Markov-kernel \(p\)-values and arbitrary score validity found the auxiliary-reference construction itself but no deterministic score-blind iff characterization.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Ramdas et al. by taking the auxiliary permutation to be the observed state.
seed_details.rebuttal: Fixing the auxiliary reference is precisely the anti-conservative construction exhibited in their paper; the deterministic row problem needs a different condition.
seed_details.drop_reason: This is mathematically clean but has less direct causal consumer value than the integrated legal-kernel and quantile angle.

seed_details.kernel: Replace the separable multiple-choice knapsack for stratified quantile nulls by a factor-graph or mixed-integer formulation for assignment-coupled network ranks.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, equations (9)--(12), Theorems 1 and 3, the dynamic-programming appendix, and the Conclusion were read. The first changed proof step is to replace the sum of stratumwise minima by shared schedule and rank-order constraints across assignments.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for network-interference treatment-effect quantiles with exact integer optimization found no coupled counterpart to the stratified multiple-choice knapsack.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Su and Li after treating each network fiber as a stratum.
seed_details.rebuttal: Strata are independent separable blocks in their reduction, whereas assignments in one fiber reuse potential outcomes and couple rank comparisons across the entire block.
seed_details.drop_reason: It is absorbed as the computational handle for S2 rather than standing alone.

seed_details.kernel: Construct a finite exact conditional test for heterogeneous direct effects at a fixed exposure, replacing inverse-probability asymptotics and nuisance maximization by exact schedule enumeration.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 1, its pairwise-dominance route, the empirical weather-insurance section, and the Conclusion were read. The first changed proof step is to predeclare a fully imputable fiber and enumerate compatible schedules instead of using assignment-adaptive focal sets and asymptotic weighted statistics.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for exact heterogeneous-effect tests under network interference returned sharp or partially sharp artificial experiments but no exact individual-effect-quantile procedure.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Owusu by replacing asymptotic probabilities with enumeration.
seed_details.rebuttal: Enumeration alone does not solve the nonsharp null because missing potential outcomes remain shared nuisance variables; an exact compatible-schedule optimizer is required.
seed_details.drop_reason: Without the universal kernel characterization it is too close to a computational variant of existing conditional tests.

seed_details.kernel: Prove that joint inversion over exposure-indexed compatible schedules equals projection to simultaneous lower bands for all finite-population individual-effect quantiles.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, the exposure-probability and Horvitz--Thompson construction, the variance derivations, and the Conclusion were read. The first changed proof step moves from average exposure contrasts to a common finite schedule whose order statistics must remain compatible across overlapping fibers.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for network quantile effects found recent inference for outcome-distribution quantile contrasts, not quantiles of individual exposure effects under fixed potential outcomes.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from exposure mapping plus Caughey et al.'s simultaneous band.
seed_details.rebuttal: Separate fiberwise maximizers can be mutually incompatible because the same potential outcomes enter several exposure contrasts, so a common-schedule projection lemma is new and necessary.
seed_details.drop_reason: The cross-exposure version is deferred; the selected core proves or asks for simultaneity within one predeclared exposure fiber.
